title: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon
shortDescription: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon helps define a Wii fighting path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Offers a clearly labeled fighting route through the Wii collection.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Recorded for the Wii fighting discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains a deterministic catalog-method entry rather than a provider verdict.
